_README: Every date the course shows students lives in this file. To roll the course to a new semester, copy this file, change the dates, and change nothing else. Dates are 'MMM D' and are combined with YEAR by the templates.
_TIMES: CLASS_START_TIME is the time every 'due at the start of class' deadline in the course reads. Confirmed: the class meets M/W 9:30-10:45 AM. CLASS_END_TIME is that start plus the 75-minute block.
_SESSION_DATES: 27 held sessions. Labor Day (Sep 7) and Thanksgiving (Nov 25) absorb two meetings.
_SESSION_DAYS: Weekday names, used in student-facing prose ('due Wed, Sep 23').
_DELIVERABLE_SCHEDULE: Checkpoints are due at the session they are due at, so they read the session keys above rather than repeating a date. The mapping: License/OSS S05 - CP1 S06 - CP2 S07 - CP3 draft S08 - CP3 S09 - CP4 + Pitch Day S10 - Charter + teams announced S11 - design draft S12 - CP5 + CP6 S14 - CP7 S16 - CP8 S18 - MVP Plan S20 - CP9 + CP10 + progress demo S22 - CP11 S25 - dry run S26 - CP12 Demo Day. Move a session date and every deliverable on it moves with it.
_DEMO_DAY: BYU assigns the final block by class meeting time within Dec 12-17. CP12_DUE and DEMO_DAY_WINDOW are placeholders until the registrar confirms the slot.
_LINKS: Shared external links, so a dead URL is fixed in one place.
_COURSE_FACTS: Room and prerequisites. Both are read by the syllabus.
